sections.title: Improved
items: Both sound sliders now reach 300% instead of 200%, for up to +9.5 dB of extra loudness.
Settings up to 100% sound exactly as before, and the bundled sounds stay free of distortion at the new maximum.

sections.title: Improved
items: Save-replay Hold guidance is now available in all 16 supported languages.
The translated guidance identifies the controller button and minimum hold duration needed to save a replay.

sections.title: Improved
items: Controller binding labels and capture prompts now show the effective Hold duration, including the configured default.
Save-replay assignment guidance states how long to hold the button without changing existing bindings.

sections.title: Added
items: Interface and capture sound sliders now reach 200%, providing up to +6 dB of gain without changing existing volume levels through 100%.

sections.title: Fixed
items: The capture border settings, the new capture notifications and the capture sound controls now appear in your own language instead of English.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Capture feedback, border, notification and manual replay-idle settings now apply without discarding the replay buffer; only recording parameters re-arm it.

sections.title: Added
items: Capture sounds now have their own volume in Settings, separate from the interface volume, and a preview button that plays the real capture sound so the level can be set without taking a screenshot.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Every skipped or failed screenshot and every failed clip save now shows a clear notification stating the reason. When a capture file is written but cannot be added to the library, the notification says "Saved to disk, not in library" instead of claiming it was saved.

sections.title: Added
items: Screenshot and replay requests now immediately play an acknowledgement sound and show a request-received notification, according to your feedback settings. Saving can still fail; the final outcome is reported separately.

Replay preview thumbnails are now decoded and encoded on the export thread, keeping image work off the capture worker while saving. The gallery still receives the thumbnail associated with the saved clip.
Capture results update the original request notification in place. The visible notification stack is limited to four cards; older cards leaving the stack do not affect saved captures.

sections.title: Fixed
items: A capture request that is refused early now says so in the log. Pressing save clip while the replay buffer was cold, busy or paused previously left no record of the press at all.
A screenshot skipped because the foreground window is not a game is now recorded with the reason, instead of passing without a trace.

sections.title: Added
items: Every screenshot and clip request now carries an id and the device that pressed it, so one press reads as one chain in the log from start to finish or to the reason it failed.
The copied diagnostics now list the bindings of the controller in your hands next to the shared controller bindings.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Interface sounds no longer report themselves as loaded before Windows has finished loading them. Each sound now records when it becomes playable, or why it could not be used.
If any interface sound is unavailable, GameHQ shows a single warning instead of staying silent without explanation. The new warning text uses English until the planned translation pass.

sections.title: Added
items: Capture settings now let you request Windows capture-border suppression. The setting is on by default and applies to the next capture session without interrupting the current session or replay buffer.
Capture settings explain the Windows border-suppression result without promising that a border is invisible. The new explanations use English until the planned translation pass.

sections.title: Neu
items: GameHQ ist jetzt in sechzehn Oberflächensprachen verfügbar. Beim ersten Start richtet sich GameHQ nach Ihrer Windows-Sprache, und in den Einstellungen können Sie eine andere auswählen.
Ein Sprachwechsel wird sofort in der gesamten Anwendung wirksam, einschließlich Overlay und Infobereichsmenü, ohne GameHQ neu zu starten. Ihre Auswahl wird gespeichert.
Das Installationsprogramm wird jetzt in Ihrer Sprache ausgeführt und übergibt diese Auswahl an den ersten Start von GameHQ, sodass Installation und Anwendung dieselbe Sprache verwenden.
Auch die Playnite-Erweiterung und die Fehlerdialoge des Startprogramms sind lokalisiert.

Neuerungen werden in Ihrer Sprache angezeigt, sobald eine übersetzte Fassung dieser Hinweise vorliegt. Andernfalls erscheint stattdessen der vollständige englische Text, niemals eine Mischung aus mehreren Sprachen.

sections.title: Geändert
items: Datums-, Zahlen- und Mengenangaben richten sich jetzt nach der ausgewählten Sprache statt nach der Systemvorgabe.

sections.title: Bekannte Einschränkungen
items: GameHQ ist weiterhin eine unsignierte Beta, daher kann Windows beim Ausführen des Installationsprogramms vor einem unbekannten Herausgeber warnen.
